name: Samui Yoru ni Aisu o Kau
original_name: 寒い夜にアイスを買う
source:
''It's cold today so let's eat ice cream.''

Conversations in front of a convenience store with a slightly grumpy acquaintance.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9182]Novel Game[/url].]
translation:
“今天天气冷，我们吃冰淇淋吧。”

在便利店前与一位脾气稍显暴躁的熟人的对话。

[翻译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9182]小说游戏[/url]。]
